Recorded shapes of `gh` 2.103 output (`gh secret list --json name,updatedAt`,
`gh api repos/…/environments`, `gh api repos/…/actions/organization-secrets`,
`gh repo list --json nameWithOwner,isArchived`, and gh's error lines). Owners,
repos and secret names are made up; GitHub never returns secret values, so
there is nothing secret here to begin with.
